DISCHARGE SUMMARY
Diagnosis: Migraine without aura.

MEDICATIONS:
1. Sumatriptan 50 mg tablets -- take one tablet at the start of a migraine. You may take one more after 2 hours if needed. Do not take more than 200 mg in 24 hours.
2. Ondansetron 4 mg tablets -- take one tablet every 8 hours as needed for nausea.

FOLLOW-UP: Follow up with the neurology clinic in 4 weeks.

RETURN PRECAUTIONS: Call your doctor if your headaches happen more than 4 days in a month, or if you notice vision changes.

Note: call the pharmacy at 555-0100 for refills.
